{{Short description|Professor of statistics}}
'''Lynn Kuo''' (born 1949)<ref>Birthdate from [https://www.worldcat.org/identities/lccn-n2014017970/ Worldcat]</ref> is a professor emerita of statistics at the [[University of Connecticut]]{{r|profile}} known for her work on statistical decision theory,<ref> The admissibility of the empirical distribution function MP Cohen, L Kuo '' The Annals of Statistics'' 1985 [PDF] projecteuclid.org</ref><ref> Minimax estimation of a variance TS Ferguson L Kuo ''Annals of the Institute of Statistical Mathematics'' 1994 Springer [PDF] ism.ac.jp</ref> software reliability,<ref>''Handbook of Statistics'' Software Reliability Volume 25 2005 pages 929-963 https://doi.org/10.1016/S0169-7161(05)25033-2</ref> and  [[Bayesian inference in phylogeny]]. With Ming-Hui Chen and Paul O. Lewis, she is the author of ''Bayesian Phylogenetics: Methods, Algorithms, and Applications'' (CRC Press, 2014).{{r|larget|oaks}}

==Education and career==
Kuo did both her undergraduate and graduate studies at the [[University of California, Los Angeles]],{{r|nestat}} completing her PhD in 1980. Her dissertation, supervised by [[Thomas S. Ferguson]], was ''Computations and Applications of Mixtures of Dirichlet Processes''.{{r|mgp}} She has worked at the [[Jet Propulsion Lab]], the [[United States Department of Agriculture]], and the [[Statistical and Applied Mathematical Sciences Institute]] before joining the Connecticut faculty.{{r|nestat}}

She was the treasurer of the New England Statistical Society,{{r|nestat}} and has also worked as treasurer for the International Chinese Statistical Association.{{r|isca}}

==Awards and honors==
Kuo is a [[fellow of the American Statistical Association]], and an elected member of the [[International Statistical Institute]].{{r|nestat}} In 2013, she won the Outstanding Service Award of the International Chinese Statistical Association.{{r|isca}}
